assistantMailboxUnavailable: The Kun server has not opened personal assistants yet.
assistantMailboxLoginRequired: Sign in to your Kun account to connect personal assistants.
assistantMailboxKeyMissing: Enrolled from another computer; tasks can only be sent from there.
assistantMailboxRemoveConfirm: Remove {{name}}? It will stop receiving tasks from Kun.
assistantMailboxDialogHint: Pick an assistant you use. Kun adds a conversation for it to your list and writes a prompt; the assistant follows it to install kun-agent on its own cloud computer and ask to join.
assistantMailboxRequestHint: Allow only if the assistant reported exactly this code in its chat.
assistantMailboxNoKeyForRequest: This code was created on another computer. Approve the request there.
assistantMailboxAttentionBody: Open Kun to check its verification code.
assistantMailboxCodeExpired: This enrollment code expired or was cancelled. Close this window and add the assistant again.
assistantPreviewRequest: Asking to join, compare the code
assistantPreviewEnrolling: Waiting for it to install kun-agent and ask to join
assistantPresetNoteCue: Has a terminal and email-triggered automations
assistantPresetNoteGrokBot: Only /workspace persists, so the program lives there
assistantPresetNoteMuse: Allow Kun's server in Sentinel so it can connect
assistantPresetNoteDots: Its cloud computer needs a terminal
assistantPresetNoteHark: Runs in its Handoff computer and needs terminal access
assistantPresetNoteToday: Always-on computer; Skills can schedule the checks
assistantOtherNote: Any assistant that can run terminal commands and check in on a schedule
assistantNoSecretHint: No secret inside: nobody can join with it unless you allow them here
assistantThreadIntro: Every message you send {{name}} is a task. It checks in about every 20 minutes, and progress and results come back here.
assistantCancelTaskConfirm: Cancel "{{title}}"? The assistant learns about it the next time it checks its inbox.
assistantConnectedBody: From now on, every message you send here is a task for it. Kun can also hand it work from other conversations, and progress and results come back to this one.
assistantSuggestionInbox: Find emails that need a reply
assistantComposerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
assistantNudgeHint: Copy a reminder to paste into the assistant's own chat so it checks its inbox now
assistantComposerAfterConnect: You can give it tasks once it is connected
assistantComposerAfterApprove: You can give it tasks once you allow it
assistantPromptSubtitle: Paste it into its chat and it installs everything itself
assistantPromptUnavailable: This code was created on another computer, so its prompt can only be shown there.
assistantWaitTitle: Waiting for {{product}} to ask to join
assistantWaitBody: Once kun-agent is installed it runs login and tells you a 10-character verification code in its chat. When the request arrives, Allow and Reject show up here.
assistantApproveInfo: Once you allow it, Kun and {{product}} each derive the same mailbox key. The key never passes through the server or appears in any chat.
assistantUpdatesNotConfigured: Signed updates are not configured for this build yet.
assistantVipRequired: Personal assistants require Pro or Max. Refresh after activating or renewing membership to resume the existing connection.
assistantVipUnavailable: Membership could not be verified. Personal assistants are paused. Refresh membership and try again.
assistantDeliveryDownloaded: Saved on the assistant; awaiting consumption confirmation
assistantDeliveryConsumed: The assistant adapter confirmed receipt. Execution results determine completion.
assistantCancellationNeedsAttention: Cancellation could not be delivered. Check the connection or ask the assistant to stop directly.
assistantHistoryExpired: Some server history is outside its retention window. Local history is preserved.
assistantRecoverHistoryConfirm: Resume from retained server history and keep all local tasks. Expired history without a local copy cannot be recovered.
